name: Archive Inspector
description: Inspect the entry list and content preview of ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ and GZIP archives.

hints.data: The archive is supplied as Base64.
hints.output: Entry count and uncompressed size are capped: an archive can declare an enormous size and would otherwise exhaust resources.

faq.q: Does it extract the whole archive?
faq.a: Only the listing and a preview are read, and the run stops as soon as the total exceeds the limit.
No. Encrypted archives need a passphrase and this tool does not accept one.
